items: Back up to Files or OneDrive: the app remembers when and where, reminds you in the bell after 3 days, and offers a backup after you sign.
The office sees when each report was emailed, and when each iPad was last used.
Fixes: verifying before signing is needed only once; engineer signatures are removed if the report changes after signing.
Easier activation: the key email has a link and QR code that open a page with one Copy button. Then tap Paste Key in the app.
The activation screen shows your progress: Install, Send code, Paste key.
Service history on each system: tap a system under Clients to see its latest 10 visits (what was wrong, what was done, the result). It works offline, and your own signed reports show at once.

The Contacts tab is now called Clients. Clearer wording: changes you send now say Waiting for approval, Sent for approval and Not approved. Shared data is called the master list, and the person who approves is the database admin.
Update a client on site: edit the address and general phone, edit a contact, mark a contact who left, rename or retire a department. Your change shows at once as waiting and it is approved.
Request a correction of a client name or code, with a reason.

Update a system on site: edit install, commissioning and PM dates, location and asset tag, correct a serial number, and add, replace or remove parts. Your change shows at once as waiting and it is approved.
Coverage is kept by the database admin. You can request a correction, with a reason.
New instrument screen: tap a system under Clients to see its details, install and PM dates, location, parts and coverage (warranty or service contract, kept by the database admin).
Getting a new key after you already used some FSR numbers is smoother: the app tells the license activator your last used number, and your numbers continue after it.
Older iPads (iOS 12 and earlier, such as the iPad mini 2) now show a clear message instead of a blank screen. The app needs iPadOS 15 or newer.
Old FSR number keys that are not tied to a device are no longer accepted. If your numbers need a new key, the app shows your device code to send to the license activator.
The update notice in the bell now shows what is new before you update.
FSR number blocks activated earlier are checked against this device. If a block needs a new key, the app shows the device code to send to the license activator.
FSR number keys are now tied to one device. The activation screen shows your device code to send to the license activator.
On an iPad, add the app to the Home Screen before activating.
The office register refuses an FSR number that was already used on another device.
Star your favorite customers, contacts and systems: they are listed first.
Recently used customers appear at the top of the customer list.
Check Details on site: confirm or correct the customer, contact and system against the nameplate. Corrections go for approval.
